_from.description: Document handle of the transcript that contains the feature, for example mm_transcripts/ENSMUST00000192972.

_to.description: Document handle of the sub-transcript feature, for example mm_genes_structure/ENSMUST00000192972_ENSMUSE00001343744_exon.

source.description: The dataset this edge was loaded from.

version.description: GENCODE release the annotation was taken from.

source_url.description: Link to the GENCODE annotation file this edge was derived from.

name.description: Predicate describing the relationship in the _from to _to direction: the transcript contains this feature.

inverse_name.description: Predicate describing the same relationship in the _to to _from direction: the feature is contained in the transcript.
